newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila approves mineral production sharing pacts.
newsitem.headline: Manila approves mineral production sharing pacts.

text.p: The Philippine environment and natural resources department approved 26 mineral production sharing agreements in 1996, constituting 40 percent of total such accords approved since 1991, the government said on Sunday.

Nine of the 26 agreements were with cement companies for the exploration and extraction of limestone, six with sand, gravel and rock aggregates and five for the stone industry, including marble and perlite, the government statement said.
The other agreements dealt with metallic deposits, it said.
